caption: The drawing depicts a standing male figure with dark brown skin, wearing a green headband and a draped reddish-brown garment that partially covers his left shoulder and falls behind his body. Around his neck, he wears a choker-like necklace, and there is a band or bracelet on his upper left arm. A strap crosses his chest from his right shoulder to his left side, adorned with three round white or light-colored ornaments. His skirt is brown and decorated with a pattern resembling layered leaves or feathers. The figure stands barefoot on a rectangular brown base, and his right arm is bent with the hand resting on his hip, while his left arm is raised with the palm facing outward. The background is plain and light beige, with subtle color variations and some mottled areas.
title: Cigar Store Indian
